name: union_view
description: A view whose body is a UNION ALL must resolve its output columns, not register a zero-column table -- the previous mini-resolver only handled SetExpr::Select and returned an empty column list for any other query shape
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE a (id integer NOT NULL, v text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE b (id integer NOT NULL, v text NOT NULL)
CREATE VIEW ab_union AS SELECT id, v FROM a UNION ALL SELECT id, v FROM b
